           CALTHA PALUSTRIS

         Cowslip


Pain in abdomen, vomiting, headache, singing in ears, dysuria and diarrhœa.
        Anasarca.



Skin.--  Pemphigus. Bullæ are surrounded by a ring. Much
        itching. Face much swollen, especially around the eyes. Itching eruption on thighs.
        Pustules.   Uterine cancer  .



Dose.--  Tincture.
